description_en: Retrieves monitoring data for an EAIS Jupyter instance. The data includes GPU utilization, GPU memory utilization, CPU utilization, and memory utilization
description_zh: 查询EAIS Jupyter实例的监控数据，包括GPU使用率、GPU Memory使用率、CPU使用率、Memory使用率
kebab_example: aliyun eais get-instance-metrics --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id eais-hznzre6ffmz9num40000 --metric-type MemoryUsage --start-time 2022-11-22T16:00:00Z --end-time 2022-11-22T16:30:00Z --time-step 5m --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceMetrics

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the instance.
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the EAIS instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the EAIS instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The metric type. Valid values:

- GpuCoreUsage: GPU utilization

- GpuMemoryUsage: GPU memory utilization

- CpuCoreUsage: CPU utilization

- MemoryUsage: Memory utilization
parameters.description_zh:
指标类型。取值范围：

- GpuCoreUsage：GPU使用率

- GpuMemoryUsage：GPU Memory使用率

- CpuCoreUsage：CPU使用率

- MemoryUsage：Memory使用率

parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.description_en: The start time of the query. The default value is one hour before the current time. Both UNIX timestamps and time strings are supported. Time strings must be in UTC and in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ format.
parameters.description_zh: 开始时间，默认取值为当前时间减1小时。支持时间戳和时间字符串，时间字符串格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ，采用UTC +0时区。
parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The default value is one hour before the current time. Both UNIX timestamps and time strings are supported. Time strings must be in UTC and in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ format
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，默认取值为当前时间减1小时。支持时间戳和时间字符串，时间字符串格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ，采用UTC +0时区
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end time of the query. The default value is the current time. Both UNIX timestamps and time strings are supported. Time strings must be in UTC and in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ format.
parameters.description_zh: 结束时间，默认取值为当前时间。支持时间戳和时间字符串，时间字符串格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ，采用UTC +0时区。
parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The default value is the current time. Both UNIX timestamps and time strings are supported. Time strings must be in UTC and in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ format
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，默认取值为当前时间。支持时间戳和时间字符串，时间字符串格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:SSZ，采用UTC +0时区
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en:
The time step size. The default value is 5m. Valid units:

- h: hour

- m: minute

- s: second

If a unit is not specified, seconds (s) is used by default.
parameters.description_zh:
时间步长，默认值：5m。支持的时长单位的取值范围：

- h：小时。

- m：分钟。

- s：秒。

当值不带单位时，默认使用单位：s（秒）。
